utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s set for Sunday at the community center. I’m keeping an eye on the list, so I’ll pass along any updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive too. Let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — thanks, Vik. If anything on the list changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send over the broken items and names right away so you can get the repair drive moving. I’m also letting neighbors know about it now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn — that really helps. I’m ready to get things moving as soon as those broken items and names come in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll get that list to you right away, and I’ll keep spreading the word to the neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning around 10 should work for me, but I may need to wrap up around school drop-off. Can you send the exact details when you have them?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, Saturday at 10 works. I’ll send the exact details and bring the tools and any spare screws I can find.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Uli — that works. I’ll watch for the details, and I may need to slip out right after school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m waiting on that list too, so I can plan what to bring without doubling up. Let me know as soon as Cleo drops it off.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll wait for Cleo’s list and bring whatever’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo—once you have it, please pass it along so I can check my supplies and avoid duplicates.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I’m still catching up. What’s the latest on what needs fixing and who’s handling what?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m not fully up to speed either, but I can bring a few tools and help wherever you still need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out a bit—what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — that would help a lot. We’re set for Sunday at the community center now, and I’m still confirming the exact room and a few supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Glad to help. Let me know if you need me to grab any supplies or help set up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to confirm, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I come.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—it's on for Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday at the front porch. I can check the exact room if you want.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that helps. Yes, please check the exact room, and I’ll confirm the details before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—what should I tackle first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: First, let’s make a clear list of what’s broken and who’s handling each job. Once that’s set, the repair drive can really get moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—I’ll start the list and keep track of who’s doing what. Just point me to the first few broken things and I’ll jot them down.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m in for the repair drive, so send them over when you can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — I’ll send them your way. I can jump in on the fence if you still need another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, thanks — another pair of hands on the fence would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive—I’ve been a bit out of the loop. I should check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Noah — I can send you a quick list of the latest updates. Just let me know if anything’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — please send the latest updates and I’ll look them over. I’ll get back to you once I’m caught up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just point me to the first repair, and I’ll get on it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s start with the porch light—if you handle that first, I can line up the next one.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll handle the porch light first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Just checking in—did you find the exact room for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, but I can check and confirm the exact room for the repair drive. I’ll also make sure we’ve got the supply list ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that’d help. Can you confirm the room and tell me if anything else is needed?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik. I’ll keep it simple and send anyone interested your way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Eli — that helps a lot. Just send folks my way and I’ll keep the repair drive simple and organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Vik. I’ll point any helpers your way and keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m checking for the first urgent repair now, Jules, and I’ll send it your way. If anything else pops up, I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo — send the first urgent one over when you spot it, and I’ll keep an eye out for anything else too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’m on it and I’ll send the first urgent one as soon as I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still a bit out of the loop on the repair drive. I should check what’s new and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem — just let me know what’s missing when you check, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’ll check and let you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, I’m coming — I’ll bring my toolbox and see what else is needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, so you’re confirmed for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m confirmed — I’ll be there with my toolbox and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — send over the list when you can, and I’ll keep an ear out for what’s still needed at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — I’m still catching up on what’s new, so I’ll check the repair drive list and send it over when I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No rush — just send it when you’ve got it, and I’ll keep an ear out here.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you find the exact room for the repair drive yet, Dane?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Not yet, sorry—I’m still waiting to hear which room it’s in. If you need extra help, I can still jump in on the fence.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—let me know as soon as you hear the room. And yes, I may take you up on the fence help if we need it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we’ve got and make a list of what still needs to be gathered for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — that would help a lot. Once you’ve got the list, I can see what’s realistic to organize.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll go through the supplies today and send you the list once I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m in for the repair drive. Send me the list of broken items and I’ll help spread the word fast.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll check what’s left and send you the list of broken items soon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—send it over when you can, and I’ll get the word out right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s definitely happening—please spread the word that the repair drive is on!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’m still checking the exact room. I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Sunday at the community center sounds good—just let me know the room when you’ve got it and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still trying to keep it aligned with the school schedule—do we have a time set for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure we’ve locked one in yet—want me to help check with the school and figure out a good time?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure thing — what part of the repair drive do you want me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can help sort and check the donated parts, but I still want to confirm what time I should be there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great — could you come by around 10? I’ll be there then, and we can sort the donated parts together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, right—the repair drive is happening, and I’m still piecing it together from updates. Eli said we need a clear list of what’s broken and who’s handling each job first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll help make a clear list first. What’s broken so far, and who’s already on each job?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up, but I know we’re missing a full rundown of what’s broken. Once I get the latest, I’ll pass along who’s already taking each job.
